Design a rectangular electronics enclosure body. The outer dimensions are 70 mm in length (X) by 50 mm in width (Y) by 30 mm in height (Z), centered at the origin with the base at Z=0. Apply a 4 mm radius fillet to the four vertical edges. Remove the top face (+Z) and shell the body inward with a 2 mm wall thickness. Inside the enclosure, create four solid cylindrical screw bosses, each with an 8 mm diameter and a 28 mm height, extending from the inner floor (Z=2) to the top rim (Z=30). Position the bosses symmetrically at ±27 mm in the X-axis and ±17 mm in the Y-axis from the center. Finally, create a 3 mm diameter vertical through-hole centered on each boss, passing completely through both the boss and the bottom floor of the enclosure.
